name: Khaemenes Preschool · Crechè

resources.title: Crechè Open Adventure Garden
resources.description: Open Preschool family learning home with 52 child adventures. Games, apps, stories, creative tools, and browser-local favorites require no registration.

resources.title: Khaemenes Preschool Guest Mentor
resources.description: Open guided Preschool Mentor with temporary session choices and age-aware activity planning. No registration or learner account is required.

resources.title: Khaemenes Family & Learner Registration
resources.description: Academy-wide registration for formal curriculum pathways that require persistent progress, assessment, portfolio, certification, or cross-grade learner records.

mentorNotes: Crechè games/apps and the Khaemenes Preschool Mentor are open without registration. Guest Mentor settings are temporary session context. Registration belongs to formal curriculum pathways that need persistent learner-specific academic records.
